description_en: Queries Layer 7 forwarding rules by calling DescribeDomains
kebab_example: aliyun ddoscoo describe-domains --source-ip 1.1.1.1 --resource-group-id test --domain www.aliyun.com --query-domain-pattern fuzzy --offset 0 --page-size 10 --instance-ids example-string --api-version 2017-12-28 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDomains

parameters.help_en: The source IP address of the request. You do not need to specify this parameter. The system automatically obtains the value
parameters.help_zh: 请求源IP。无需填写，系统自动获取
parameters.name: source_ip

parameters.help_en:
The query matching mode. Valid values:

fuzzy: fuzzy match (default)
exact: exact match
parameters.help_zh:
查询匹配模式。取值：

fuzzy：模糊查询（默认）
exact：精确查询
parameters.name: query_domain_pattern

parameters.help_en: The start index, which specifies the position from which results are displayed. Default value: 0
parameters.help_zh: 开始索引位置，即从第几条结果开始显示。默认从0开始。
parameters.name: offset

parameters.help_en: The number of records on each page. Maximum value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页大小，即每页显示多少条记录。最大值10。
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The Anti-DDoS Pro and Anti-DDoS Premium instance ID. To specify multiple instances, pass in InstanceIds.1, InstanceIds.2, InstanceIds.3, and so on
parameters.help_zh: DDoS高防实例ID。若指定多个实例，依次传入InstanceIds.1, InstanceIds.2, InstanceIds.3,
parameters.name: instance_ids
